notes: All 1,137 physical subject rows / 1,110 family-card identities across 53 sections are reconciled from original glyph origins. All 25 Austin 3:16 cards, numeric-leading 1986/2025 captions, the 61 Iconic Imprints autograph rows and 30 1986 autograph rows retain their actual families. Names, WWE designations and 13 literal Rookie flags remain separate; designations are not teams. The two buyback rows retain blank designation cells. Thirty-three exact guide limits cover the 200-card base I/II program and five named insert/autograph families; no limits propagate to Base III, Sapphire, geometric or other colors.
